A governed restatement of a lot&#x27;s open basis after acquisition, retained on the lot of record and in its append-only mutation. Bases are stated for OpenQuantity in durable lot units; later relief scales them by the remaining open quantity. The acquisition facts never change, so the original basis stays provable while the open basis follows governed policy.

The position principal must be the lots&#x27; held par face (par face × open share, summed) × (prior − new), rounded once to the currency&#x27;s minor units away from zero — the projector&#x27;s own arithmetic — so the factors determine it exactly. Each lot&#x27;s raw share is par face × open share × (prior − new); every lot first takes its raw share truncated to minor units, and the minor units left over go one each to the lots with the largest truncated remainders, ties to the later lot (largest remainder). Every lot&#x27;s principal is therefore non-negative, never more than its raw share rounded up, and the lots sum to the position principal exactly. Each lot&#x27;s open bases are relieved pro rata to the principal repaid, which for a lot at the prior factor is the ratio new ÷ prior, rounded per lot, so a full paydown leaves zero basis exactly; across several lots the currency rounding of principal and basis is recognised in the realized result. |

## OpenLotFactorPaydownInstructionDto

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Contracts.Accounting.Lots.OpenLotFactorPaydownInstructionDto</code>. Kind: `record`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Contracts/Accounting/Lots/OpenLotFactorPaydown.cs:29](../../../../src/Meridian.Contracts/Accounting/Lots/OpenLotFactorPaydown.cs#L29).

Reviewed in-place principal paydown of every open face lot of one (security, book position) scope. Each lot&#x27;s open basis is relieved pro rata to the principal it repays; the difference between principal and relieved basis is the premium or discount embedded in the repaid principal and is recognised as realized gain or loss. A new factor of zero is a full paydown that closes every lot. Same-currency lots only; this is not an FX translation.

```csharp
public sealed record OpenLotFactorPaydownInstructionDto(EconomicEventReferenceDto EconomicEvent, ProjectionLineageDto Lineage, AssetAccountingEventScopeDto Scope, long ExpectedPeriodVersion, string ExpectedSecurityHash, decimal PriorFactor, decimal NewFactor, decimal PrincipalPaydown, string Currency, IReadOnlyList<OpenLotFactorPaydownLotDto> Lots);
```
